title: Fix quoted-field handling in a hand-written CSV parser
prompt: The hand-written CSV parser in this project (`csvlite.parse_line`, used by `csvlite.read_records`) breaks on quoted fields. Do not switch to the `csv` module; fix `parse_line(line, delimiter=",")` so it follows these rules: a field is quoted only if its first character is a double quote; inside a quoted field the delimiter is literal and a doubled quote ("") stands for one literal quote; the surrounding quotes are removed; after the closing quote the next character must be the delimiter or the end of the line, otherwise raise ValueError; a quoted field that is never closed raises ValueError; in an unquoted field every character (including quotes and spaces) is kept verbatim; an empty line yields [""]; a trailing delimiter yields a trailing empty field; empty fields are "". It returns a list of strings. Run the tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
